description: Image Description: The image contains a single, vertical, white line centered against a black background. The line is straight and appears to be of uniform thickness throughout its length. It is positioned centrally in the frame, extending from near the top to near the bottom of the image. There are no other objects, textures, or visual elements present in the image. The contrast between the white line and the black background is stark, making the line highly visible and prominent. The overall composition is minimalistic and geometric
